name: CENNETIC 52iY Reverse-Interpolation Turn-Mill Machining Center
summary: The CENNETIC 52iY is a reverse-interpolation turn-mill machining centre that produces a virtual Y-axis through two coordinated X-axes instead of a physical Y slide. Removing the Y-axis overhang shortens the cutting-force path and lowers the centre of gravity, giving a more rigid, more accurate platform for heavy cutting of titanium, superalloys and hardened steel (up to HRC 58–62) in a single chucking.
body:
The CENNETIC 52iY is a reverse-interpolation turn-mill machining centre that produces a virtual Y-axis through two coordinated X-axes instead of a physical Y slide. Removing the Y-axis overhang shortens the cutting-force path and lowers the centre of gravity, giving a more rigid, more accurate platform for heavy cutting of titanium, superalloys and hardened steel (up to HRC 58–62) in a single chucking.

About this model

This Turn-Mill Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
